Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear requirements. We can accommodate consolidated monthly delivery via SFTP and will also send an email copy to ap@acmetech.com as a fallback.

Questions and proposed approach:
1) SFTP: We can push two files each month to your ingest host: a CSV summary and a ZIP containing PDFs (or individual PDFs if you prefer). Please provide hostname, preferred path, username (we’ll request a temp public key), and whether you accept key-based auth.

2) Filenames and prefixes: We’ll use the ACME- prefix you requested. Example names: ACME-2027-07-summary.csv and ACME-2027-07-invoice-98765.pdf. If you’d like a different delimiter or ordering, let us know.

3) VAT evidence: We can attach VAT_certificate_acme.pdf to the first invoice of the quarter. For the invoice rendering, we’ll include your VAT number and apply reverse-charge text where appropriate; please confirm your VAT number and whether Acme is registered in the EEA for reverse charge purposes.

4) PO mapping and reconciliation: We’ll put PO 98765 in the invoice header and add a column in the CSV mapping line-items to PO(s).

5) Payment terms: Our standard is Net 30; if you need Net 45 or a different banking format (SEPA), confirm and we’ll include necessary remittance instructions in the PDF. For higher security, bank details can be shared via our secure billing portal (link below).

I’ve copied Marissa from billing to help configure the outgoing workflow; Ben will be feeding the invoice generator. Once you send SFTP details + VAT number we’ll run a one-off test file for July.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
